args: mkdir "C:\Program Files\bucket\include\bucket" 2>nul & xcopy /E /I /Y "${workspaceFolder}\include\bucket" "C:\Program Files\bucket\include\bucket\" & mkdir "C:\Program Files\bucket\doc" 2>nul & xcopy /E /I /Y "${workspaceFolder}\docs" "C:\Program Files\bucket\doc\" & copy /Y "${workspaceFolder}\README.md" "C:\Program Files\bucket\doc\"

tasks.label: Create distribution package (Linux)
args: VERSION=$(grep -oP 'project\(bucket VERSION \K[0-9.]+' CMakeLists.txt) && PKGDIR=bucket-$VERSION && mkdir -p $PKGDIR && cp -r include docs README.md LICENSE CMakeLists.txt cmake $PKGDIR/ && tar czf $PKGDIR.tar.gz $PKGDIR && rm -rf $PKGDIR
tasks.detail: Create a distributable tarball containing headers, documentation, and build files

tasks.label: Create distribution package (Windows)
args: $version = Select-String -Path CMakeLists.txt -Pattern 'project\(bucket VERSION ([0-9.]+)' | %{$_.Matches.Groups[1].Value}; $pkgdir = "bucket-$version"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $pkgdir; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force include,docs,README.md,LICENSE,CMakeLists.txt,cmake $pkgdir/; Compress-Archive -Path $pkgdir -DestinationPath "$pkgdir.zip" -Force; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $pkgdir
tasks.detail: Create a distributable ZIP file containing headers, documentation, and build files
